name: Existing normal short farm grass terrain: mostly ↗ A low raised grassy mound / elevated turf
lower_description: Existing normal short farm grass terrain: mostly a flat solid muted medium green #43894f, with extremely sparse tiny 1-2 pixel grass strokes in #4e9557 and #397d48. Simple clean low-detail cozy farming-game pixel art, 16x16 tiles. Match this dark normal grass as the lower ground. Straight-on front-facing 2D game view, horizontal front edge, ground top visible slightly from above; no isometric, diagonal or three-quarter side view. No flowers, stones, weeds, bushes, shadows from objects or outlines around tiles.
upper_description: A low raised grassy mound / elevated turf platform one small step above normal grass. PALE lighter soft spring-green short-grass top (#8cbd75, #76ac64, #a5cc86), clearly lighter than the lower #43894f grass. Mostly plain smooth turf with very sparse tiny 1-2 pixel marks, same simple cozy farming pixel-art style. Broad walkable flat grass top, not tall grass blades. A rounded organic lawn patch raised only 3-4 pixels with a thin dark green turf lip and warm ochre-brown earthen front face. Straight-on front-facing 2D game view, horizontal front facade, grassy top visible slightly from above; no isometric, diagonal or three-quarter side view. No rock pillars, stone walls, cliffs, water, flowers or props.
transition_description: A shallow 3-4 pixel-high warm earth ledge under a thin overhanging pale-green turf edge. Front-facing bank reads as a short vertical step; upper and side borders are subtle. Complete seamless convex and concave corners between normal dark grass and raised pale grass.

target_palette.name: Fantasy farm green meadow, pale raised turf, warm earth banks
